components.css: .ds-inspector { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-inspector header { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-inspector h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.03em; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-inspector h3 { margin: 0 0 9px; font-size: .88rem; } .ds-inspector p { margin: 0; color: #414958; font-size: .84rem; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-inspector header button { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 15px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--accent); color: #fff; font: 700 .87rem/1.2 var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; } .ds-inspector header button:hover { background: var(--accent-strong); } .ds-inspector header button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-inspector dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; margin: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-inspector dl > div { padding: 18px 20px; } .ds-inspector dl > div + div { border-left: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-inspector dt { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-inspector dd { margin: 5px 0 0; font-size: 1.65rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-inspector dd small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-inspector section { padding: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-inspector .ds-evidence { background: var(--surface-muted); } .ds-activity { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin-top: 8px; color: var(--positive); font-size: .79rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-activity i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

narrative.overview:
BuzzRouter is a calm, information-dense developer workspace for choosing one community with confidence. A cool canvas holds white working planes; compact factual rows remain visible beside a persistent inspector, so browsing and evaluation feel like one continuous task rather than a sequence of promotional pages.

The system is precise without becoming clinical. Graphite type, electric-indigo selection, written emerald activity, and crisp dividers create hierarchy with almost no decorative depth. The binding BuzzRouter logo anchors the masthead and favicon, while the rest of the interface stays light, planar, and factual.
keyCharacteristics: Index and inspector remain visually connected on wide screens.
Electric indigo identifies the current item, current route, and decisive action.
Activity appears as plain language with a small emerald dot, never as a decorative chart.
Compact Instrument Sans typography carries both interface and content.
White working planes and precise dividers do most of the structural work.
The BuzzRouter logo appears as a circular brand asset in the masthead and browser identity.

rules.name: The One Interaction Color Rule
rules.body: Electric indigo carries selection, navigation, links, and action; semantic colors do not become general accents.

rules.name: The Written Status Rule
rules.body: Emerald, ochre, and red supplement explicit status language; color never carries meaning alone.

rules.name: The One Grotesk Rule
rules.body: Use Instrument Sans for brand wordmark text, interface, labels, metrics, and reading copy; vary scale and weight instead of introducing a second typeface.

rules.name: The Compact Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Keep the workspace hierarchy shallow; large display type belongs to secondary content pages, not above the index.

rules.name: The Context Stays Put Rule
rules.body: Preserve the index while inspecting a community; wide layouts use a persistent side inspector, and narrow layouts place the inspector directly after the selectable list.

rules.name: The Facts Before Ornament Rule
rules.body: Use aligned columns, consistent row geometry, and dividers to make comparison effortless; do not replace factual density with cards or decoration.

rules.name: The Flat Working Plane Rule
rules.body: Index rows, inspectors, command bars, fields, and content cards stay shadowless at rest; only overlays and small physical key hints cast shadows.

rules.name: The Precise Divider Rule
rules.body: Let 1px rules describe adjacency and reading order; rounded containers must not dissolve the index-and-inspector structure.

dos: Do use the BuzzRouter logo in the masthead and favicon at its shipped circular proportions.
Do keep the selected community and Join action visible in the first workspace view.
Do preserve compact factual rows and the adjacent or immediately following inspector.
Do pair activity color and dots with plain-language status and freshness.
Do retain 44px interactive targets, visible focus, reduced-motion behavior, and non-color status cues.
Do use indigo sparingly for current route, selection, links, tags, and decisive action.
donts: Don't generalize the logo’s dark dimensional material into UI panels, buttons, or container shadows.
Don't turn the directory into promotional cards, a chart dashboard, or a social feed.
Don't add waveforms, sparklines, decorative squiggles, or other invented activity graphics.
Don't introduce dark-neon, glass, gradient, terminal, civic-ledger, or Craigslist-derived styling.
Don't hide the inspector behind a route change when the index and selection can remain in context.
Don't use semantic emerald, ochre, or red as general-purpose emphasis.
